title: Mock language model array results are call-indexed after recording calls
summary: MockLanguageModelV2/V3/V4 record doGenerate and doStream calls before selecting from array backed scripted results, so array lookup must use call count minus one. MockEmbeddingModelV3/V4 have the same doEmbed pattern and
body:
MockLanguageModelV2/V3/V4 record doGenerate and doStream calls before selecting from array-backed scripted results, so array lookup must use call count minus one. MockEmbeddingModelV3/V4 have the same doEmbed pattern and need the same indexing. Issue #15141 and Vercel Agent Review verified this across language V2/V3/V4 and embedding V3/V4; focused tests live in src/test/mock-language-model.test.ts and src/test/mock-embedding-model.test.ts.
Evidence: Initial failing tests showed embedding mocks returned the second scripted result on the first call. Vercel Agent Review then flagged MockLanguageModelV2 on PR #15154. After patching, targeted Vitest passed 8 tests.
Verified by: pnpm --filter ai exec vitest --config vitest.node.config.js --run src/test/mock-language-model.test.ts src/test/mock-embedding-model.test.ts; pnpm --filter ai type-check; pnpm type-check:full; pnpm exec ultracite check targeted files
